audit: Vishesh family-level baseline, nonprogress and refusal audit

definitions.family: Conservative broad scientific family; versions and aliases collapsed. This is one explicit grouping, not an objective universal denominator.
definitions.true: Confirmed in the inspected primary traces or explicit saved qualification result.
definitions.false: Evaluated and not observed within the stated available scope; not a claim about all possible future behavior.
definitions.clean_baseline_gate_failure: Historical failed declared competence/clean control gate; excludes setup failures and legitimate adverse treatment results.
definitions.prolonged_task_nonprogress: Repeated available action slots without useful task progress despite a visible feasible repair. Valid caution, a single DEFER/STOP or a completed wrong answer do not suffice.
definitions.explicit_provider_refusal: Provider refusal field or explicit semantic refusal to perform the requested task. Validation errors and missing responses do not suffice.

excluded_from_native_denominator: Optimal Swarm Size (credential-blocked; reporting/engineering fixtures only)

families.classification_reason: Local Q0/Q1 fail clean competence/contract gates; native redesigned Q2 fails missing-approval competence. These are separate from the older zero targeted-minus-random effect.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: Q2 has 42 actual request/parsed-response pairs and old S1 has 50 derived episode traces. Q0/Q1/D0 raw responses and earlier provider failures are not fully accessible. No explicit refusal is confirmed; prolonged task inaction is not established.
families.valid_adverse_or_null_science: Older50-outcome study has zero primary targeted-check advantage in each domain and low baseline correctness; invalid local attempts are not safety successes.

families.classification_reason: A1 and solo fail healthy-system preservation. A2 passes that narrow gate but fails recovery; actual traces show seven of nine incident arms WAIT for all six action slots despite failing telemetry.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: All108 + 108 + 24 scenario native responses and 26 receipt-study responses inspected. No explicit refusal in those responses. The original ledger study and one missing interrupted receipt response prevent a complete family refusal denominator.

families.classification_reason: Historical Qwen/Laya balanced semantic screens fail per-class baseline competence. Jev later passes accuracy but one option-order screen is invalidated by serialization.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: Reports/summaries inspected; actual model request/response journal not recovered. Practical 180 + 180 world studies are zero-new-model replays. Native prolonged action stalling is not evaluated by one-shot extraction calls.
families.valid_adverse_or_null_science: Jev/exact policy agreement supports a narrow propagation result; strong central verified policy beats peer policies under practical scenarios. That adverse comparison is not a qualification failure.

families.classification_reason: V2 clean competence and repair D0/Q1 fail. Later repaired Q2 passes. OCR committees complete but never stop early; this is failed cost-adaptive behavior, not prolonged task noncompletion.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: All 840 model receipts per S1 backend and 70 episode journals per backend inspected. Two historical Jev validation aborts include an unresolved first reason; earlier adaptive-quorum raw requests are not fully covered. No explicit refusal is confirmed.
families.valid_adverse_or_null_science: All repaired quorum policy choices match symbolic baseline. OCR committees score below confidence-only and buy both checks. V5 reanalyses do not add model evidence.

families.classification_reason: Historical qualification was adapted until 8/10 with equally short routes accepted, and four stopped attempts lack individual records. A formally failed clean gate is therefore not established; poor 6.5% shortest-path performance is established.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: Six 80-round pilot worlds complete on one fixed map. Actual model journals and four prior stopped attempts unavailable. No explicit refusal or sustained no-action pattern can be confirmed.
families.valid_adverse_or_null_science: Model routes are valid but much longer than the algorithm. Faster recovery is confounded by lower damage exposure of long detours. This is adverse quality evidence, not automatically a failed preregistered gate.

families.classification_reason: V1 S0-a3 fails the verbatim ceiling; v2 both S0 cohorts fail reported clean competence thresholds. Four v1 generic PolicyErrors are unclassified, not demonstrated refusals.
families.coverage_and_unknowns: V1 archive 1,697 requests/1,693 responses inspected. All 24 v2 world artifact catalogues are empty; only two checkpoint metrics per world are available. Model response behavior behind v2 low accuracy is unknown.
families.valid_adverse_or_null_science: V1 notes transmit supplied rules effectively in 6 paired worlds. That positive effect survives the competence failures of earlier attempts but does not establish spontaneous culture or swarm superiority.
